stemMd: Which institution is correctly matched to its general function?

options.label: B
options.textMd: European Council — issuing all national building permits

options.label: D
options.textMd: European Commission — directly electing every mayor

options.label: E
options.textMd: European Court of Auditors — setting school curricula

explanationMd: The ECB's central role concerns euro-area monetary policy. The other pairings assign unrelated national or local functions to EU bodies. EU institutions have defined powers rather than general control of every public decision.

distractorRationale.c: Parliament is a legislative and representative institution.
distractorRationale.e: Its remit is EU financial auditing.
distractorRationale.b: These are not issued by this EU leadership body.
distractorRationale.d: Local democratic processes are outside that role.
